INTERVIECTION

The Chineseng is an ideal destination for those who wish to be temporarily separated from their routine of living and regain their peace in clean sea space. TodayTourist accompanied you to explore the Chinese sea streets – where cool sea winds, pleasant air and gentle pace of life bring a feeling of complete rest after busy working days.

With the Blue Sea, White Sand, Long Coast and the familiar sights such as Mount Tao Baid, the Modern Mountains, the Chinese Gong creates a balanced natural painting, suitable for both rest and tour. At sea, breathing salted wind and enjoying fresh seafood such as shrimp, crabs, crabs, ink... will bring you a pleasant, comfortable, and memorable journey.
